import MumfordLib.EventuallyZeroCochainSum
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionCochainIteration
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionFiniteChains
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionSmallOperators

/-!
# Primitives for singular cocycles vanishing on small chains

For an open cover, a cochain vanishing on small chains evaluates to zero on
every sufficiently subdivided chain. Summing the subdivision homotopy
pointwise therefore gives a cochain. For a cocycle, its coboundary telescopes
to the original cocycle.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}

/-- A cochain vanishing on small chains eventually vanishes on every
subdivided chain. -/
theorem singularCochain_eventually_subdivision_eq_zero
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X n)
    (hφ : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫ φ = 0)
    (c : (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K,
      (((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ).hom c = 0 := by
  let a : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom ((LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf ℤ ℕ _).symm c)
  have ha : a.hom 1 = c := (LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf ℤ ℕ _).apply_symm_apply c
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := singularChain_eventually_subdivision_small_factor U hopen hcover a
  refine ⟨K, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hK k hk
  have he : a ≫ ((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hd, Category.assoc, hφ, comp_zero]
  simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ha, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply] using
    congrArg (fun f : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ => f.hom 1) he

/-- The homotopy series of a cochain vanishing on small chains is pointwise
finite. -/
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopy_eventually_eq_zero
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hφ : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0)
    (c : (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K,
      (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
        ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ) c = 0 :=
  singularCochain_eventually_subdivision_eq_zero U hopen hcover φ hφ
    ((singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n).hom c)

/-- The pointwise finite homotopy sum of a cochain vanishing on small chains. -/
def singularSmallCochainPrimitive
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0) :
    IntegralSingularCochain X n :=
  eventualCochainSum
    (fun k => singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
      ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ)
    (singularSubdivisionHomotopy_eventually_eq_zero U hopen hcover φ hsmall)

/-- On cocycles, the homotopy sum has coboundary equal to the original cochain. -/
theorem singularSmallCochainPrimitive_coboundary
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0)
    (hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0) :
    singularCochainCoboundary (singularSmallCochainPrimitive U hopen hcover φ hsmall) =
      φ := by
  let f : ℕ → IntegralSingularCochain X n := fun k =>
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
      ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ
  have hf : ∀ c, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, f k c = 0 :=
    singularSubdivisionHomotopy_eventually_eq_zero U hopen hcover φ hsmall
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  let g : ℕ → ℤ := fun k =>
    (((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ).hom c
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := singularCochain_eventually_subdivision_eq_zero
    U hopen hcover φ hsmall c
  change ∀ k ≥ K, g k = 0 at hK
  have hterm (k : ℕ) :
      f k ((IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n c) = g k - g (k + 1) :=
    congrArg (fun θ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1) => θ.hom c)
      (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_pow_coboundary φ hφ k)
  change eventualCochainSum f hf ((IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n c) = φ c
  rw [eventualCochainSum_apply_eq_sum f hf _ K (fun k hk => by
    rw [hterm, hK k hk, hK (k + 1) (hk.trans (Nat.le_succ k)), sub_self])]
  simp only [hterm]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_sub', hK K le_rfl, sub_zero]
  simp [g]

/-- A positive-degree singular cocycle vanishing on the small chains of an
open cover is a coboundary. -/
theorem singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_zero_on_small
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0)
    (hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0) :
    ∃ ψ : IntegralSingularCochain X n, singularCochainCoboundary ψ = φ :=
  ⟨singularSmallCochainPrimitive U hopen hcover φ hsmall,
    singularSmallCochainPrimitive_coboundary U hopen hcover φ hφ hsmall⟩

/-- Subdivision iterates preserve the annihilator of small chains. -/
theorem singularCochain_subdivision_pow_zero_on_small
    (U : ι → Set X) (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X n)
    (hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫ φ = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫
      ((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ = 0 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hsmall
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [pow_succ, End.mul_def, Category.assoc]
      exact small_operator_comp_cochain_eq_zero U (smallSingularSubdivisionMap U n)
        (singularSubdivision X n) (smallSingularSubdivisionMap_inclusion U n)
        (((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ) ih

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The pointwise primitive of a cochain vanishing on small chains also
vanishes on small chains. -/
theorem singularSmallCochainPrimitive_zero_on_small
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0) :
    (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫
      singularSmallCochainPrimitive U hopen hcover φ hsmall = 0 := by
  have hz (k : ℕ) : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫
      singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
        ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ = 0 :=
    small_operator_comp_cochain_eq_zero U (smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap U n)
      (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n) (smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_inclusion U n)
      (((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ)
      (singularCochain_subdivision_pow_zero_on_small U φ hsmall k)
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  change (∑ᶠ k, (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
    ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ)
      ((smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n c)) = 0
  have he (k : ℕ) := congrArg (fun θ => θ.hom c) (hz k)
  simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, finsum_zero] using finsum_congr he

end Mumford.Analytic
